calls.title: Saved Group Approval Flows Review
calls.summary: The team discussed relocating Approval Flow settings to a dedicated tab to manage increasing complexity and introduce saved groups with permissions for modification. Concerns about usability led to suggestions for navigation improvements, including search functionality and reorganization of tabs. Modifications to saved groups now require permission-based approval, with deletions blocked if the group is in use. The team debated user notifications for pending approvals and consensus was reached on landing users on the overview tab for clarity. Future steps include creating a prototype for a page-per-review model to enhance user experience and reduce interface complexity.
calls.keywords: Approval Flow, Saved Groups, Revision, Change Set, Audit Log, User Interface
